how.title: How it works
how.verifyBody: Prove you're one human with World ID, by Orb or document, and a sponsor pays for your first bundle. Do it on the phone that will use the eSIM: the activation code opens only in the browser that claims it.
how.installBody: Three ways, all on the install screen. Needs an eSIM-capable, carrier-unlocked phone.
how.installHere: On this phone: tap Install eSIM on an iPhone, or paste the code into Android's settings.
how.installQr: From another screen: scan the QR code with the phone.
how.installManual: By hand: type the SM-DP+ address and the activation code.
how.topupBody: Add 100 MB at a time for {price} in USDC; it lands on the same eSIM. Data stops when the plan expires.
how.giftBody: Send data to an ENS name. They claim it with their wallet or the 16-digit PIN; if they don't, you can reclaim the USDC.
how.agentBody: An agent buys 100 MB when your plan runs low, up to a daily cap. You approve it with World ID.
esim.title: How the eSIM works
esim.data: A travel eSIM with mobile data and no phone number.
esim.sim: Your home SIM stays in beside it and keeps your calls and SMS.
esim.apps: WhatsApp and similar apps keep working over the data line.
esim.phone: Needs an eSIM phone that is carrier-unlocked: iPhone XS, Pixel 3, Galaxy S20 or later.
esim.install: Install it on Wi-Fi: the phone downloads the eSIM over the internet.
esim.topup: Top-ups land on the same eSIM; nothing to reinstall.
esim.expiry: Data stops when the plan expires.

verify.footnote: One free bundle per human, not per phone.
